profile.name: Miodrag Strak
profile.professional_headline: AI Product Architect | Technical Product Manager | Automation & Product Operations
profile.career_summary: Product and technology professional focused on AI products, automation, product operations, and the delivery of practical digital solutions. Combines product leadership, stakeholder management, workflow design, quality assurance, and hands-on technical implementation across AI, business automation, tourism, legal technology, tax advisory, and decentralized manufacturing projects.
profile.current_status: Open to AI product, technical product management, product operations, automation, and solution architecture opportunities.

projects.title: AI Professional Profile
projects.summary: Conceived, architected, and developed a public MCP-based professional profile that enables AI systems to access controlled, structured, and verifiable career information.
key_contributions: Defined the product concept and V1 MCP contract.
Designed controlled profile, source, snapshot, review, and publication data models.
Built and deployed the public MCP server.
Implemented GitHub snapshot ingestion and manual review workflows.
outcomes: Public MCP endpoint deployed on Render.
The get_profile tool was verified through external MCP clients.
Established controlled separation between source data, reviewed facts, and published profile data.

Developed and reviewed decentralized fabrication-verification and Proof-of-Make concepts.
outcomes: Defined the MVP concept and product architecture.
Created a public prototype demonstrating fabrication verification.
Developed a marketplace implementation in a related repository.
